map.根据鸡种类型和日龄生成科学的光照程序，包含光照时长和强度建议: Generate a scientific lighting program by breed type and age, with duration and intensity advice
map.📖 查看「鸡舍光照程序设计器 使用指南」: View "Poultry house lighting program designer" guide
map.• 育雏期前3天：23~24h强光照，促进采食饮水: • First 3 days brooding: 23–24 h bright light, promote feeding/drinking
map.• 育成期：恒定或递减光照，防止性早熟: • Growing: constant or decreasing light, prevent early maturity
map.• 产蛋期：恒定16h光照，不可随意减少: • Laying: constant 16 h, do not reduce freely
map.• 光照强度：育雏 30~40 lux，育成 5~10 lux，产蛋 15~20: • Intensity: brooding 30–40 lux, growing 5–10 lux, laying 15–20 lux
map.• 光照时长变化比绝对时长更影响性成熟: • Light-length change matters more than absolute length for maturity
map.• 产蛋期光照只能增不能减，强度只能增不能减: • During laying, light can only increase, not decrease; so can intensity
map.• 开放舍需结合自然光照补充人工照明: • Open houses need supplemental artificial light over natural
map.• 灯泡建议使用暖白光 LED，色温 2700~3000K: • Use warm-white LED bulbs, color temperature 2700–3000 K
map.本程序为通用参考方案，实际生产中需根据品种手册、季节和鸡群发育状况灵活调整。: This is a general reference; adjust flexibly by breed manual, season and flock development.
map.按鸡种（蛋/肉/种）与日龄给出光照时长。: By breed (layer/broiler/parent) and age give light duration.
map.密闭舍补充光照至目标时长。: Closed house add light to target duration.
map.产蛋期建议恒定 16 h 光照（密闭舍自然 12h 须补 4h），促进排卵。: Laying: constant 16 h (closed house natural 12 h needs +4 h) to promote ovulation.
map.前期 23h 促采食，后期降至 18~20h 平衡生长。: Early 23 h promotes intake; later drop to 18–20 h to balance growth.
map.光周期调控性成熟与产蛋，过长/短均影响产量与健康。: Photoperiod controls maturity and laying; too long/short hurts yield and health.
map.自然光照随季变，须人工补光达到目标时长。: Natural light varies by season; add artificial to reach target duration.
